report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

Reasons:
- The difference norm is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 across almost all layers, which often reflects low-level changes (e.g., embeddings/RMSNorm/scaling or handling of the BOS/first token) rather than a targeted behavioral objective.
- The logit‑lens tokens are eclectic and shift by layer: early layers lean toward generic web/reviewish words (“bottle”, “wings”, “Author”, “Best”), while later layers frequently surface mixed themes (“law”, “wrong/incorrect”, “tragic/tragedy”, “surgeon/clinic/surgery”, “Royals”, “Herald”, “Later/latter”). This mix doesn’t cohere to a single interpretable objective or domain (e.g., it is not consistently safety/refusal language, coding, math, or a clear topical shift).
- Patchscope readouts are not provided, so there’s no behavioral continuation evidence to corroborate a specific change.

There is a recurring cluster around “law/tragic/surgeon/clinic” in later layers at positions 2–4, but on its own it’s too ambiguous to ascribe to a particular training objective or domain shift.
